verdict.rationale: Runloop has a dedicated docs page for controlling automatic shutdown and idle behavior of devboxes, and separately documents suspend/resume to save costs, so the core capability is first-party. The evidence is only a page summary, though, with no detail on how timeouts are configured or confirmation that billing stops. Missing for 10: explicit timeout/idle-duration configuration parameters, documented confirmation that billing stops on shutdown or idle, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set timeouts so sandboxes shut down automatically and stop billing when idle or done

citations.quote: Control devbox automatic shutdown and idle behaviors
Pause sandboxes to save state and costs, then resume exactly where you left off
